pending_reviews.title: Rolls-Royce Spectre Series II Gets More Power And Range, But You'll Really Care About The Redesigned Clock And Absurd Trim Options
pending_reviews.summary: The overall design hasn't changed much, but the new Spectre gets some of the wildest and most impressively intricate options you've ever seen on a car.
